name: Ca khoai Cai Doi Vam
summary: Cá khoai Cái Đôi Vàm is dried cá khoai from the drying village of that coastal town. It is a bag to carry home rather than a plate.
origin: Thị trấn Cái Đôi Vàm, huyện Phú Tân, as of 24 October 2020. Cá khoai Cái Đôi Vàm is a collective trademark.
howToEat: Carry it home as dried fish.
For the fresh fish in a pot, order lẩu cá khoai.
seoTitle: Ca khoai Cai Doi Vam — dried fish from the coast
seoDescription: Cá khoai Cái Đôi Vàm is dried cá khoai from the drying village of that Cà Mau coastal town, a collective trademark to carry home.
